issues.description: The return type of Stock.take is inconsistent across artifacts: the problem statement's class diagram specifies +take(String): int, the solution implementation defines public int take(String), but the template Stock.java declares public boolean take(String). This mismatch will prevent students from implementing SealSaloon following the specification/solution (e.g., solution and problem expect to check for -1 to detect failure), causing compilation or logic errors.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template's Stock.take method match the specification and solution by changing its signature from boolean take(String) to int take(String) and implement the same contract as in the solution: return -1 if the ingredient is missing or quantity < 1, otherwise decrement the quantity and return the new quantity. Alternatively, update the problem statement and solution to consistently use the boolean return contract, but keeping the int return (and -1 sentinel) is recommended to match the UML.
